description: Default capability for the GameLib shell: core defaults plus the opener plugin (the shell.openExternal / steam:// parity path) and the dialog plugin's open-folder-picker path (dialog.showOpenDialog parity, plan 30-03). The four app-defined relay commands (sidecar_invoke, sidecar_send, open_external, sidecar_store_snapshot) are registered via invoke_handler and do not require capability permissions in Tauri v2.
